behavior: A touch outside an open popup closes it only at a tap. A tap ends with `pointerup` in less than 1 s and moves 15 px or less: Chromium sends `click` for a move of 15 px and not for 16 px. A touch that scrolls the page ends with `pointercancel` and closes nothing, as a native popover stays open in Chromium and WebKit. A drag of more than 15 px on an element that does not scroll also closes nothing. There, Chromium keeps a native popover open, and Safari closes it. In Base UI, a touch that scrolls the page closes a Popover, a Menu or a Select.
